multimodal_prefix_insert_exact_fp32.description: Copies each declared FP32 prefix row exactly into its decoder row and writes zero placeholder token IDs without arithmetic conversion.

multimodal_mrope_positions_2d_int32.description: Builds four section-major integer M-RoPE position planes for a mixed text-before, rectangular visual-grid, and text-after sequence.

audio_wav_pcm16_parse_channel_mean_fp32.description: Bounds-checked RIFF/WAVE PCM16 parsing followed by deterministic source-frame window selection and ascending-channel mono FP32 decoding.

audio_pcm_s16_mono_fp32.description: Interleaved signed-16 PCM channels are averaged in ascending channel order and scaled by exactly 1/32768 into mono FP32 samples.

audio_resample_linear_rational_fp32.description: Deterministic linear resampling from exact integer-rate rational coordinates; this reference capability is not a substitute for a future band-limited provider.

audio_resample_windowed_sinc_fp64_accum_.description: Band-limited resampling with exact integer-rate output positions, cutoff=min(1, output_rate/input_rate), a finite Hann-windowed sinc radius, ascending-tap FP64 accumulation, normalization, and FP32 storage.

audio_pad_or_truncate_prefix_zero_fp32.description: Copies the available sample prefix exactly, truncates excess input, and zero-fills a short input to the circuit-declared sample extent.

audio_stft_periodic_hann_tables_fp32.description: Constructs the periodic Hann window and FP32 cosine/sine tables consumed by the selected STFT provider.

audio_stft_centered_hann_precomputed_fp3.description: Centered periodic-Hann STFT power using explicit precomputed trigonometric tables and the same ascending-sample FMA order as the scalar direct reference.

audio_stft_centered_hann_fft400_radix20_.description: Whisper-width 400-point centered periodic-Hann STFT power using a fixed 20x20 Cooley-Tukey factorization and precomputed FP32 trigonometric tables. This provider intentionally has a different reduction tree from the direct DFT reference.

audio_whisper_mel_filters_slaney_fp32.description: Constructs Whisper's Slaney-normalized triangular Mel filter bank from explicit sample-rate, FFT-width, and Mel-count dimensions.

audio_whisper_log_mel_from_power_fp32.description: Projects a frame-major STFT power checkpoint through explicit Slaney Mel filters, then applies Whisper log10 clipping and normalization.

audio_whisper_global_log_mel_feature_win.description: Whisper long-form frontend contract: compute STFT and normalization against the complete 16 kHz PCM stream, slice at a hop-aligned global source offset, and zero-pad missing feature frames after normalization.

audio_conv1d_channel_major_ascending_fp3.description: General channel-major FP32 Conv1D with explicit stride, symmetric zero padding, independent output-channel rows, bias-first accumulation, and deterministic channel/kernel traversal within each output.

layout_channel_to_token_copy_fp32.description: Exact FP32 layout copy from channel-major [C,T] to token-major [T,C].

position_embeddings_add_token_major_fp32.description: In-place token-major addition of learned absolute FP32 position embeddings with no interpolation or reduction.

position_embeddings_add_offset_token_maj.description: In-place token-major addition of learned absolute FP32 position embeddings beginning at the explicit runtime decode position.

attention_query_key_scaled_ordered_fp32.description: Equal- or unequal-length head-major query/key attention with explicit query scaling, ordered FP32 QK and PV products, and an FP64 softmax denominator.

attention_query_key_scaled_ordered_fp32_.description: Head-major FP32 attention with planner-owned transposed-K scratch and AVX2 lanes across independent keys while preserving each key's ascending-dimension FMA chain.

attention_query_key_tiled_f16kv_fp32_onl.description: Equal-length bidirectional head-major attention with FP16-rounded K/V tiles, bounded scratch, and deterministic online FP32 softmax in ascending key-tile order.

audio_whisper_log_mel_reference_fp32.description: Whisper-compatible FP32 reference frontend with PyTorch reflect centering, periodic Hann framing, scalar direct DFT power, explicit Slaney Mel weights, log10 floor, eight-decade clamp, and affine normalization.

gated_deltanet_prefill_ordered_fp32_stat.description: Gated DeltaNet prefill carries one FP32 recurrent state through prompt rows in ascending token order and delegates each update to the exact decode provider.

gated_deltanet_llama_fused_prefill_fp32_.description: Production llama.cpp fused Gated DeltaNet prefill: prompt tokens update recurrent state in ascending order with compact Q/K groups tiled over independent value heads. Head-parallel execution preserves every per-head FP32 reduction tree.

gated_deltanet_llama_avx2_decode_fp32_st.description: Single-token Gated DeltaNet matching llama.cpp's grouped-Q/K CPU graph: compact Q/K groups tile over value heads, followed by four-vector FMA dot reduction, FMA state update, and query scaling after reduction.

gated_deltanet_llama_avx2_prefill_fp32_s.description: Prompt Gated DeltaNet matches llama.cpp's scalar-gate 64-token chunk graph: compact Q/K groups tile over value heads, cumulative gate decay and the lower-triangular WY transform are built per chunk, and recurrent state is carried across chunks in ascending order.

recurrent_norm_gate_llama_avx2_fp32_outp.description: Qwen3.5 recurrent gated normalization matches llama.cpp's separate RMSNorm, weight multiply, AVX2 SiLU, and final elementwise multiply operations.

recurrent_norm_gate_pytorch_bf16_storage.description: PyTorch Qwen3Next BF16 RMSNormGated boundaries: FP32 RMS statistics, BF16 norm/weight product, FP32 SLEEF SiLU, and BF16 final storage.

rmsnorm_fp32_square_fp64_sum_fp32_output.description: RMSNorm with FP32 square products, an ascending FP64 row sum, FP32 mean and reciprocal square root, and ordered FP32 normalization and weight multiplies.

rmsnorm_llama_cpu_production_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp CPU production RMSNorm: FP32 squares, ascending FP64 row sum, and the active CPU provider reciprocal-square-root sequence. AVX-512 uses RSQRT14 plus one Newton refinement; AVX2 uses scalar sqrt/div.

rmsnorm_pytorch_avx2_cascade_bf16_storag.description: PyTorch CPU AVX2-dispatched BF16 RMSNorm: materialized FP32 squares, ATen cascade_sum reduction, ordered FP32 division/rsqrt sequence, BF16 normalized storage, then BF16 weight multiplication and output storage. Provider ISA follows the PyTorch build, not the host maximum ISA.

rmsnorm_qwen3next_pytorch_avx2_bf16_stor.description: Qwen3Next BF16 RMSNorm keeps normalization and weight multiplication in FP32 and rounds only the final output to BF16.

bf16_weight_bf16_input_fp32_dot_fp32_out.description: BF16 weights and BF16-rounded FP32 activation loads with an ascending-K FP32 dot product and FP32 output storage.

bf16_tiled_2d_align_corners_rne_residual.description: Align-corners tiled 2D bilinear position interpolation with FP32 rational coordinates and explicit BF16 RNE product, accumulation, residual, and output boundaries.

fp32_tiled_2d_antialias_half_pixel_contr.description: Antialiased half-pixel FP32 interpolation with contraction enabled and channel-row-column evaluation before merged-tile output, matching the GGML execution contract.

fp32_tiled_2d_align_corners_contracted.description: Align-corners tiled 2D position interpolation with FP32 rational coordinates and contracted float32 evaluation order.

recurrent_qk_l2_llama_cpu_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp CPU L2 normalization: FP32 products, ascending FP64 sum, and epsilon as a minimum denominator.

recurrent_qk_l2_pytorch_bf16_vector_tail.description: PyTorch CPU BF16 recurrent Q/K l2norm, including BF16 square storage, ATen cascade reduction, Vec<BF16> 32-value rsqrt iterations, the distinct scalar tail, and BF16 output storage.

recurrent_silu_llama_avx2_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp x86 SiLU provider, including the production AVX-512 or AVX2 vector exponential approximation selected at compile time and the scalar tail.

ssm_conv1d_llama_scalar_mul_add_fp32_out.description: llama.cpp GGML_OP_SSM_CONV production arithmetic: each channel/token output is an ascending scalar FP32 chain with a rounded product before every addition. The provider prevents contraction or vectorization from changing rounding boundaries.

ssm_conv1d_llama_fma_fp32_output.description: Contracted llama.cpp GGML_OP_SSM_CONV arithmetic observed when the compiler and target contract the source expression: each channel/token output is an ascending scalar FP32 fmaf chain. Contraction is a build property, not a source-revision guarantee. This remains an independently certified candidate until its earlier Qwen3.6 end-to-end divergence is attributed.

ssm_conv1d_pytorch_fp32_compute_bf16_out.description: PyTorch BF16 causal depthwise convolution: BF16-valued operands are accumulated in FP32 in ascending kernel order and the raw convolution result is stored to BF16 before SiLU.

recurrent_silu_pytorch_sleef_bf16_input_.description: PyTorch CPU BF16 SiLU boundary for the recurrent convolution path: consume BF16 storage, use the SLEEF vector exponential lane, and store the SiLU result to BF16.

gated_deltanet_pytorch_grouped_qk_fp32_s.description: Qwen3.6 BF16 Gated DeltaNet provider: expand compact Q/K groups across adjacent value heads using group = head / (H / G), retain FP32 recurrent state, and store the attention output to BF16.

yarn_rope_cache_contiguous_positions_fp3.description: Parameterized YaRN cache for contiguous positions 0 through T-1, using configured correction bounds, interpolation factor, and mscale ratio with FP32 cache storage.

yarn_rope_cache_explicit_positions_fp32.description: Parameterized explicit-position YaRN cache using configured correction bounds, interpolation factor, and mscale ratio with FP32 cache storage.

yarn_rope_cache_explicit_positions_bf16_.description: Parameterized explicit-position YaRN cache with FP32 arithmetic and RNE BF16 cache storage at the PyTorch consumption boundary.

text_mrope_fp32_input_fp32_compute_fp32_.description: Text M-RoPE rotates the configured prefix of each head using one semantic text position expanded across four axis-selection streams.

text_imrope_fp32_input_fp32_compute_fp32.description: Text M-RoPE uses full-width split-half rotation with Qwen-style interleaved temporal, height, width, and reserved-axis selection.

text_imrope_bf16_input_pytorch_bf16_comp.description: PyTorch BF16 text M-RoPE contract: FP32 frequencies, BF16 cos/sin, BF16 products and BF16 output storage. Unreplaced interleaved tail frequencies retain the temporal axis.

text_imrope_positions_fp32_input_fp32_co.description: Explicit-position Qwen3-VL M-RoPE for segmented quantized mixed prefill with FP32 input, compute, and output.

text_imrope_positions_bf16_input_pytorch.description: PyTorch BF16 decoder M-RoPE over an explicit four-axis position tensor: FP32 frequencies, BF16 cos/sin, BF16 products, and BF16 output storage.

vision_mrope_fp32_input_fp32_compute_fp3.description: Vision M-RoPE uses full-width multi-section split-half FP32 math and stores FP32 output.

vision_mrope_fp32_input_fp32_compute_bf1.description: Vision M-RoPE computes in FP32 and materializes a BF16 RNE storage boundary in the FP32 activation buffer.

vision_mrope_pytorch_mkl_fp32_input_fp32.description: PyTorch CPU-compatible Qwen3-VL vision M-RoPE using direct FP32 frequencies, MKL VML trigonometry, separate FP32 products/sum, and BF16 RNE storage.

vision_mrope_fp32_input_fp32_compute_fp1.description: Vision M-RoPE computes in FP32 and materializes an FP16 RNE storage boundary in the FP32 activation buffer.

layernorm_bf16_storage_fp32_compute_ggml.description: Float-buffer LayerNorm with BF16 input/output storage boundaries and the established ggml matched mean/variance reduction.

layernorm_bf16_storage_fp32_compute_aten.description: Float-buffer BF16 LayerNorm reproducing PyTorch 2.8 ATen's AVX2 Welford chunk and cascade structure using explicit intrinsics. Validated byte-exact at the production 4032x1152 shape; stitched X-ray remains the model-level acceptance gate.

layernorm_fp32_ggml_chunked_contracted.description: GGML-compatible FP32 LayerNorm with double mean accumulation, ISA-width centered-variance chunks, contracted FP32 arithmetic, and independent-row scheduling.

bf16_weight_bf16_input_fp32_dot_bf16_out.description: BF16 weights and BF16-rounded FP32 activation loads with ascending-K FP32 dot products and BF16 RNE output storage.

fp32_weight_fp32_input_llamafile_x86_nat.description: llama.cpp CPU F32 projection order: llamafile native-width FMA accumulation with its high/low and lane 0+2, 1+3 horizontal merge for multi-token batches, and ggml_vec_dot's four-way accumulation for one-token decode.

q6_k_weight_q8_k_input_llama_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp-compatible Q6_K projection with canonical Q8_K activations, int32 sub-block dots and zero-point correction, and FP32 scaled super-block accumulation.

q5_k_weight_q8_k_input_avx2_fma_fp32_out.description: llama.cpp x86 Q5_K projection: canonical Q8_K activation quantization, integer sub-block dots, FP32 FMA super-block accumulation, and movehl/movehdup lane reduction.

q5_1_weight_q8_1_internal_fp32_output.description: CKE Q5_1 projection with internal Q8_1 quantization. The optimized M4 provider is bit-exact with the established provider; llama.cpp production-graph drift is bounded by 1e-4 in the registered oracle.

q8_0_weight_q8_0_input_llama_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp-compatible projection from pre-quantized Q8_0 activations with FP32 scaled block accumulation.

q8_0_weight_fp32_input_internal_q8_0_lla.description: FP32-input wrapper that performs canonical per-block Q8_0 activation quantization before the llama.cpp-compatible Q8_0 projection.

bf16_weight_bf16_input_native_pair_dot_b.description: BF16 weights and BF16-rounded activations using native paired BF16 dot products, FP32 vector accumulators, pairwise horizontal merge, CK threadpool independent-row partitioning, and BF16 RNE output storage.

attention_bf16_storage_fp32_online_bf16_.description: Full bidirectional head-major attention over BF16-valued Q/K/V, FP32 score/softmax/value accumulation, and BF16 RNE output storage.

attention_bf16_sdpa_tiled512_bf16_prob_f.description: Portable BF16 full attention with 512-key tiles, BF16 probability storage, FP32 tile accumulation and merge, and BF16 RNE output storage.

attention_bf16_pytorch_cpu_flash_amx_exa.description: PyTorch 2.8 CPU flash-SDPA-compatible full attention: FP64-evaluated inverse-sqrt scale narrowed to FP32, 256-query/512-key tiles, oneDNN BF16 BRGEMM using its largest even K block at or below 32 (24 for head width 72), AVX-512 exp_u20 and pairwise lane reductions, BF16 softmax probability storage, FP32 tile accumulation, and BF16 RNE output storage. Diagnose future drift against the complete PyTorch CPU-flash and oneDNN schedule; matching only scale, GEMM, softmax, or storage in isolation is insufficient.

residual_add_bf16_input_fp32_add_bf16_ou.description: Elementwise residual addition of BF16-valued float buffers with BF16 RNE output storage.

attention_gate_llama_sigmoid_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp CPU attention gating evaluates sigmoid as 1.0f/(1.0f+expf(-gate)) before the FP32 attention multiply; the algebraically equivalent sign-stable branch is not numerically interchangeable.

swiglu_fp32_ggml_vector_exp_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp CPU SwiGLU semantics: evaluate GGML's ISA-specific vector exponential, divide gate by 1+exp(-gate), then multiply by up in FP32.

swiglu_pytorch_sleef_bf16_intermediate_b.description: PyTorch 2.8 CPU BF16 SwiGLU: ATen SiLU uses SLEEF vector exp and stores BF16, followed by a separate BF16 elementwise multiply and BF16 output store.

gelu_pytorch_tanh_bf16_storage.description: PyTorch tanh-approximate GELU over BF16-valued inputs with FP32 elementwise compute and BF16 RNE output storage.

gelu_erf_fp64_scalar_fp32_storage.description: Standalone scalar ERF GELU over FP32 storage using FP64 libm evaluation and one FP32 output rounding. PyTorch comparison is observed separately because framework vector transcendental implementations vary by build and ISA.

gelu_pytorch_erf_sleef_bf16_storage.description: PyTorch 2.8 x86 exact GELU (approximate=none): AVX-512 Abramowitz-Stegun vector erf with SLEEF u10 exp over BF16 input, PyTorch 2.8 FTZ edge behavior, FP32 elementwise arithmetic, and BF16 RNE output storage.

gelu_fp32_input_fp16_table_fp32_output.description: llama.cpp CPU GELU semantics: round FP32 input to FP16, index the GGML FP16 GELU table, then widen the FP16 result to FP32.

fp16_weight_fp16_input_llamafile_x86_nat.description: FP16-weight GEMM matching llama.cpp's native x86 llamafile path, including FP16-RNE activation conversion and the compile-time ISA-specific FMA lane accumulation and horizontal reduction: AVX2/F16C uses 8 FP32 lanes with movehl/movehdup reduction; AVX-512/F16C uses 16 FP32 lanes with _mm512_reduce_add_ps.

bf16_weight_bf16_input_amx_tile32_dot_bf.description: BF16 weights and BF16-rounded activations using AMX 16x16x32 tile dot products, ascending K tiles, independent 2D output-tile partitioning, and BF16 RNE output storage.

patch_projection_bf16_pytorch_onednn_con.description: PyTorch BF16 temporal patch Conv3D parity contract. The two temporal weight planes and duplicated image frame are reduced by oneDNN as one convolution before BF16 output storage.

bf16_weight_bf16_input_shape_safe_prefil.description: Segmented BF16 prefill provider: aligned M/N/K uses the AMX tile32 contract; short or unaligned text segments use the native paired-dot contract. Both paths round input and output at the same BF16 storage boundaries.

mla_kv_decompress_bf16_weight_bf16_input.description: Expands a BF16-valued MLA latent through the checkpoint's BF16 KV-B projection, splits non-rotary key and value heads, and stores BF16-RNE values in FP32 activation carriers.

mla_partial_rope_interleaved_pytorch_bf1.description: Assembles packed MLA Q/K heads and applies pairwise-interleaved RoPE with the staged BF16-RNE arithmetic used by PyTorch CPU. Inputs and outputs are BF16 values carried in FP32 buffers.

instella_farskip_bf16_shared_swiglu_fp32.description: Observed Instella FarSkip shared-expert reference order. BF16 weights feed FP32 ascending reductions; the shared result is reused for routed-inclusive and routed-free residual streams with the reference parenthesization. Full-model PyTorch certification is still required before promotion to validated.

llama_full_softmax_topk_selected_renorm_.description: Observed llama.cpp-compatible AVX2 full-softmax top-k MoE routing order. Distinct-score Qwen3.5 production shapes are bit-exact; equal-score cross-toolchain ordering remains uncertified.

q8_0_q8_0_shared_swiglu_fp32_sigmoid_gat.description: Observed compact Q8_0 shared SwiGLU composition with a separate FP32 sigmoid gate. The gated shared product is rounded before routed addition to retain graph-operation semantics.

q4_k_q8_k_gate_up_ggml_swiglu_q5_k_q8_k_.description: Observed compact routed SwiGLU composition for Q4_K gate/up and Q5_K down experts. Constituent primitives are certified; complete llama.cpp mul_mat_id and expert-merge parity remains required before promotion.

bf16_weight_bf16_input_pytorch_onednn_br.description: PyTorch BF16 Linear parity contract for oneDNN 3.7 OpenMP BRGEMM. The result is deterministic only for a fixed thread count; changing the oneDNN K partition can alter BF16 outputs by one storage step.
